name: sqlite-encrypted-capacitor-service-log-example
description: Encrypted offline service log using Capacitor and SQLite.Encrypted

scripts.check: node --check www/js/config.js && node --check www/js/database.js && node --check www/js/app.js
scripts.add:android: npm run build && cap add android
scripts.add:ios: npm run build && cap add ios
scripts.sync:android: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.sync:ios: npm run build && cap sync ios
scripts.android: npm run sync:android && cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run sync:ios && cap open ios
